<entry id="L00551">
<head-word>לִכְלוּךְ</head-word>
<head-word>לִיכְ'</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (לִכְלֵךְ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (= לִחְלוּחַ) 
<italic>making palatable by moistening</italic>, as dipping into vinegar &c. Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>a</sup> bot. כל דבר שיש בו ל' משקה any food which is likely to be moistened with a liquid.</definition>
<notes> Ruth R. to II, 14 (ref. to וטבלת וכ' ib.) זה ל' מעשים this is symbolical of the seasoning of (Solomon’s) deeds, i.e. of his amending his deeds, v. לִכְלֵךְ.—[Pesik. Eth. Korb., p. 58
<sup>a</sup>, a. e., v. לִחְלוּךְ.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>soiling, staining</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Till. to Ps. XXIII; Yalk. Deut. 808 (play on לכתך Deut. II, 7) הילוכך לִכְלוּכְךָ וכ' thy travels, thy getting soiled and thy pains about thy support.—
<plural-form>Pl. לִכְלוּכִין, לִיכְ'</plural-form>. Mikv. IX, 4; Tosef. ib. VI, 17 לִכְלוּכֵי צואה the (moist) stains of excrements. Ib. 9 ל' פירות ed. Zuck. (ed. לכולם, corr. acc.) stains of fruit-juice. Ib. 18 ל' שמרים שבכיס the muddy sediments in the cup.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="L00552">

<entry id="L00553">
<head-word>לִכְלֵךְ</head-word>
<head-word>לִיכְ'</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (cmp. לְכַךְ) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (= לחלח) 
<italic>to moisten; to season by dipping into vinegar</italic> &c. Ruth R. to II, 14 (v. 
<xref rid="L00551">לִכְלוּךְ</xref>) של' מעשיו כחומץ ממעשים רעים he (Manasseh) amended his conduct as if with vinegar (freeing it) from bad deeds.</definition>
<notes>—Part. pass. מְלוּכְלָךְ, f. מְלוּכְלֶכֶת; 
<plural-form>pl. מְלוּכְלָכִים; מְלוּכְלָכוֹת</plural-form>. Y. Ḥag. III, 78
<sup>d</sup> מל' במשקה dipped in liquid, contrad. to מלוא משקה, opp. to נגיב. Y. Sabb. XII, 16
<sup>b</sup> top אם מל' במשקה if the cane is saturated with oil. Ker. 13
<sup>a</sup> טיפה מל' על וכ' the drop with which the nipple is moistened; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to soil, stain; to defile</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Prov. to XI, 22; Yalk. Prov. 944 (ref. to Prov. l. c.) אם … היא מְלַכְלְכוֹ בטיט if thou puttest a golden ornament on the nose of a swine, it will soil it with mud &c.; כך ת"ח … מְלַכְלֵךְ את תורתו so does a scholar … soil his learning; (Midr. Prov. l. c. מקלקל).—Part. pass. as ab. Yoma 77
<sup>b</sup> היו ידיו מלוכלכות וכ' Ms. M. 2 (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 100) if his hands are soiled &c. Gen. R. s. 65 הייתי משמשו בבגדים מל' I used to attend him in soiled (working) garments. Ex. R. s. 22, end (ref. to Job XVI, 17) מי שידיו מל' בגזל וכ' he whose hands are soiled with robbery, will call … but not be answered. Ib. s. 27, end מל' בעבירות soiled with sins. Lev. R. s. 1, v. אִסְפַּקְלַרְיָא; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְלַכְלֵךְ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְלַכְלֵךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be moistened, flavored</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. B’shall., p. 92
<sup>b</sup> מִתְלַכְלְכִין היו וכ' (not מתלכלין) they were perfumed with the moisture of the herbs &c.; v. גִּעְגֵּעַ; Yalk. Deut. 850.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be soiled</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. B. Kam. III, 3
<sup>c</sup> נִתְלַכְלְכוּ כליו (not נתכלכלו; Bab. ib. 30
<sup>a</sup> נטנפו) if his garments were soiled. Gen. R. s. 65 מִתְלַכְלֵךְ בעוונות defiles himself with sins. Ex. R. s. 23; Cant. R. to I, 5 מִתְלַכְלֶכֶת, v. כָּבַס. Esth. R. to II, 7 נִתְלַכְלַכְתִּי בטומאה I became soiled with impurity; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00565">
<head-word>לָמֵד</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>לָמַד</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be joined, affixed to</italic>, v. 
<italic>Pi.</italic></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to accustom, train</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. לָמוּד, f. לְמוּדָה; pl. לְמוּדִים, לְמוּדִין; לְמוּדוֹת. Y. Ter. IV, 42
<sup>d</sup> כמות שהוא ל' according to what he is used to. Lev. R. s. 4 אינה ל' מבית וכ' she is not used (to handle T’rumah) from her father’s house. Dem. IV, 4 ואם … ל' וכ' but if a priest or the poor are habitual guests at his table. Sifra K’dosh. Par. 3, ch. VI, v. לִימּוּד; a. fr.—3) 
<italic>to learn, study.</italic> Ab. II, 5 לא הביישן לָמֵד וכ' he who is bashful will not learn, nor can the hot-tempered teach, v. בַּיְישָׁן. Ib. IV, 1 הלוֹמֵד מכל אדם he who learns from everybody. Ib. 20 הל' ילד he who studies at an early age; הל' זקן who begins to study at an advanced age. Ib. I. 9 שמא … יִלְמְדוּ לשקר lest through them (your intricate cross-examinations) they may be led to tell a lie. Taan. 7
<sup>a</sup>; Macc. 10
<sup>a</sup> הרבה לָמַדְתִּי וכ' I have learned much from my teachers, more from my colleagues, and most from my pupils; a. v. fr.—B. Mets. 71
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. הא לָמַדְתָּ here you learn, i.e. this proves. [Targ. Esth. I, 1 מכאן אתה לָמֵד from this you will learn.]</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>לִמֵּד, לִימֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to join; to arrange</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 125
<sup>b</sup> צאו ולַמְּדוּם go out and place them (the building stones) in order (for sitting thereon the next day).—V. לִימּוּדִים.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to train, accustom</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Hor. 13
<sup>b</sup> יְלַמֵּד אדם עצמו וכ' man should train his body (to relieve his bowels) early in the morning &c. Nidd. 66
<sup>b</sup> לעולם ילמד אדם בתוך וכ' man should make it a rule in his house; a. fr.—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. מְלוּמָּד, f. מְלוּמֶּדֶת; pl. מְלוּמָּדִים, מְלוּמָּדִין; מְלוּמָּדוֹת 
<italic>trained, experienced</italic>. Snh. 109
<sup>a</sup> top (in Chald. dict.) דמל' בניסין הוא for he has experience in miracles. Taan. 25
<sup>a</sup>. Succ. 29
<sup>a</sup> מפני שמל' במכות הן (not במכותיהן; Ms. M. שרגילין) because they (the Jews) have experience in afflictions; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to teach, instruct; to argue</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 50
<sup>a</sup> הלומד … ומְלַמְּדָהּ he who studies the Law and teaches it. Pes. 112
<sup>a</sup> לַמְּדֵנִי תורה teach me the Law; איני מְלַמֶּדְךָ I will not teach thee. Ib. כשאתה מְלַמֵּד … לַמְּדֵהוּ וכ' when thou teachest thy son, teach him from a revised (correct) copy. Snh. 19
<sup>b</sup> אהרן ילד ומשה לי' וכ' Aaron begot (his sons), but Moses taught them, therefore they are recorded under his name; a. v. fr.—מְלַמֵּד תינוקות 
<italic>primary teacher</italic>. Ib. 17
<sup>b</sup>. B. Bath. 21
<sup>a</sup> מְלַמְּדֵי ת' teachers.—ל' זכות על 
<italic>to argue in favor of, to plead for</italic>; ל' חובה 
<italic>to plead against</italic>. Sabb. 32
<sup>a</sup> ואפי' … מְלַמְּדִים … ואחד מלמד עליו זכות ניצול and even if nine hundred … plead against him, and one (good deed) for him, he will be saved; a. v. fr.—Esp. (in textual interpret.) 
<italic>to lead, hint, throw light on</italic>. Sifra Emor Par. 4, ch. IV הייתי אומר תושב … בא שכיר ולי' על התושב וכ' I might have thought 
<italic>toshab</italic> (Lev. XXII, 10) meant one hired for a limited period; therefore 
<italic>sakhir</italic> (ibid.) comes in to throw light on 
<italic>toshab</italic> that it means one bought for life; Kidd. 4
<sup>a</sup>; Yeb. 70
<sup>a</sup>.—Sifra introd. יצא מן הכלל לְלַמֵּד is specified for the sake of illustration, v. כְּלָל. Meil. 11
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. שני כתובים … אין מְלַמְּדִין two verses which coincide (teach the same), prove nothing, cannot serve as an illustration for similar cases; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְלַמֵּד</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to practice</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gitt. 24
<sup>b</sup>; Zeb. 2
<sup>b</sup> בסופרים העשויים להִתְלַמֵּד וכ' it treats of scribes who are in the habit of writing documents merely for practice. Gitt. 60
<sup>a</sup> לכתוב … להתל' בה to write one portion of the Pentateuch for a child for practicing purposes; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="L00566">
<head-word>לָמֵד</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word> , </head-word>
<head-word>לְמֵדָה</head-word>
<head-word>לְמֵידָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>accustomed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Noah 2 (מה של') מה שהיה ל' what each was used to eat (ed. Bub. ib. לָמוּד).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (of persons) 
<italic>learning, arguing</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—
<plural-form>Pl. לְמֵדִין, לְמֵי'</plural-form>. Nidd. 22
<sup>b</sup> כל ג"ש … אין ל' הימנה from an analogy of textual words (v. גְּזֵרָה) which are not free for interpretation (being necessary to the subject proper), you cannot derive any general rule; ib. ל' ומשיבין we may derive a rule, but it is open to argument; a. fr.—הל' לפני חכמים those who were permitted to argue before the scholars (e. g. Levi before Rabbi). Meil. 9
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 17
<sup>b</sup> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 3). Men. 80
<sup>b</sup> ל' לפני רבי.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (of subjects) 
<italic>having light thrown upon, defined</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pes. 25
<sup>b</sup>, a. e. הרי זה בא לְלַמֵּד ונמצא לָמֵד (a proverbial phrase: behold this one comes as a teacher and turns out a learner) this is intended to throw light (on the case of a violated betrothed) and is at the same time receiving light.—Sifra introd. דבר הל' מעניינו something which is clearly understood from the context; a. fr.—Y. Kidd. I, 59

<entry id="L00683">

<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to suffer, be under a disadvantage</italic>.</definition>

III, 12 יִלְקֶה בחסר ויתר he suffers the disadvantages of loss or gain, i.e. he must pay according to the original value of his charge in case of depreciation, or according to the present value in case of a rise in value. Tosef. Yeb. IX, 3 בזו מידת הדין לוֹקָה justice suffers under this rule, i.e. it is inconsistent; Y. B. Kam. IV, beg. 4
<sup>a</sup>; a. e.—Esp. 
<italic>to be smitten, afflicted with disease</italic> (
<italic>esp. leprosy</italic>); (of crops) 
<italic>to be struck</italic> (by hail &c.); 
<italic>to be blighted</italic>. Sabb. 87
<sup>b</sup> לָקוּ בכורות the first-born (in Egypt) were smitten. Ib. 97
<sup>a</sup>; Yoma 19
<sup>b</sup> החושד … לוקה בגופו he who entertains a suspicion against worthy men, will be smitten with disease; Ex. R. s. 3 אף אתה ראוי לִלְקות בצרעת thou, likewise, deservest to be afflicted with leprosy. Ḥull. 55
<sup>a</sup> לָקְתָה בכוליא אחת if one of its kidneys is disordered.—B. Mets. IX, 7 לקתה the wheat crop was blasted.—Ber. 18
<sup>b</sup> שלו לא ל' his crop was not struck by hail.—Makhsh. IV, 3, a. e. שלא יִלְקֶה הכותל that the wall may not suffer (from the rain); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—

<italic>dak</italic> means diseased (sparse) and short hair. Yeb. 80
<sup>a</sup> כל שממעי אמו ל' one born with defective genitals. Tosef. ib. X, 6 קולו ל' his voice is abnormal (womanly, thin). Ib. 7 קולה ל' her voice is abnormal (manlike; Yeb. 80

<number>—3)</number>
